body.p: The bear. Once the Great walked through the forest. He walked, walked, his gaze rushed forward. Ahead he saw a rotten stump, he saw a large stump. He began to look from both sides. He raised his fist. He slapped the rotten stump with this fist. The rotten stump crumbled, pieces of it flew up to the sky. After that he said: âI would look at a sacred person. I would have crushed him like that, Iâm strong.â Suddenly, in the middle of the forest, he heard obscure sounds. The great one bowed his head down, down to his paws, and said: âLet not the ear of a sacred person hear. I joked. A person has a shooting arrow without noise. And I don't have a poor one. My life is protected by two fangs." And he went from this place home, through the forest thicket. Aivacedo totem is a bear. Painting by Aivacedo - fang of a bear.
